method: Identity-preserving style-transfer of existing fixed character assets; original images retained unchanged.
promptTemplate: Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 (pixel-mao-zedong) is only the pixel-art technique reference. Preserve identity, age, hairstyle, expression and clothing. Single square head-and-shoulders game avatar, whole hair within margins and large centered face. Authentic hand-placed 96x96 anime pixel-art aesthetic: crisp square pixels and stair-step outlines, compact material palettes, 2-3 cel-shade clusters, readable at 48px. Transparent background. No text, frame, extra people, blurred mosaic, smooth painting or gradients. Blobfish variant shows entire creature with fins inside margins.
postprocessing: Generated raster only resized to a maximum 512×512 with nearest-neighbor and encoded as lossless WebP. No programmatic redraw, pixelation of original artwork, or identity replacement.
